text:
Alex H: quick one — planning to show an inline "Undo" after users delete a resource in the table. attaching a quick sketch: https://redwood.design/undo-sketch :paperclip:
Maria P: nice. two copy candidates:
  1) `Undo` (compact, single-word, familiar)
  2) `Undo — Restores item for 30s` (explicit, clearer for edge cases)
Samir K: lean toward #1 for density, but only if we add accessible text for screen readers. short link + an aria hint = best of both worlds. :+1:
Design Bot: accessibility note — use `aria-live="polite"` and a descriptive `aria-label` on the link, e.g. `aria-label="Undo deletion of Pricing dataset. Restores for 30 seconds."`
Alex H: ok — placement question: inline next to the row, or sticky toast at bottom-right? Toast gives more space but can clash with other notifications. inline feels immediate.
Maria P: inline is discoverable for table users; toast is better for bulk deletes. maybe both? inline by default, toast only for multi-select delete.
Samir K: if we do inline, we should cap the text to one line. trending pattern in console: single word action + hover tooltip with details. Tooltip copy: "Restores the item for 30 seconds — click Undo to revert."
Alex H: proposed microcopy for inline link: `Undo` with tooltip text exactly: "Undo deletion — restores item for 30 seconds."
Maria P: wording nit: prefer sentence-case in tooltip: "Undo deletion — Restores item for 30 seconds." keeps it consistent with other tooltips.
Samir K: also add keyboard focus state and ensure tooltip is available to keyboard users (focus-triggered).
Design Bot: accessibility checklist: 1) link focusable via keyboard 2) tooltip exposed on focus 3) announce via `aria-live` that item was deleted and can be undone 4) provide `aria-label` on the link with full sentence.
Alex H: sounds good. I'll update the sketch and add the exact tooltip copy and ARIA attributes to the component PR. quick approvals?
Maria P: approved. :white_check_mark:
Samir K: approved, just add the aria-label example in the PR description.
Design Bot: recorded: microcopy decision = single-word inline `Undo` + tooltip "Undo deletion — Restores item for 30 seconds." + aria attributes as discussed.
